Want to experience the tactile feel of an iPad's nano-texture screen without a long-term commitment? Astropad has launched a brand-new version of Rock Paper Pencil, which not only retains the detachable design but also adds another writing texture.

Graphite feel officially arrives on Apple Pencil and iPad, as the all-new Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 hits the market

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 pairs a nano-texture screen protector with a specially designed Apple Pencil nib. For the first time, buyers can choose between the smooth feel of a ballpoint pen and the softer, paper-gripping stroke of graphite.

The new graphite nib is modelled after a 2B pencil, delivering the extra friction favoured by artists for drawing, shading and expressive line work.

Astropad says developing this new option took about a year, using a standard 2B pencil as the reference. They note the finished product also recreates the look and sound of real graphite.

Choose between ballpoint and standard pencil feel

Meanwhile, the existing steel ballpoint nib remains on offer, suited to writing, inking, drawing precise lines and tidy notes. Each Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 set now comes with four Apple Pencil nibs in total: two ballpoint and two graphite.

The screen protector itself is unchanged. Astropad's proprietary NanoCling system uses electrostatic adhesion rather than glue, so the film can be applied, removed and reused at any time without leaving residue.

The company claims the hold is stronger than magnets while still delivering a bubble-free fit and easy removal. The protector's microscopic texture mimics the tooth of fine-grain paper, offering friction and better control.

The best matte screen protector for iPad

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 isn't simply about swapping nibs or changing the screen texture — it treats the two as one complete system. Astropad notes that its custom nibs only work with the nano-texture protector. The new graphite nib is made from POM (polyoxymethylene), while the ballpoint nib uses steel.

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 is now on sale at US$49.99 with free worldwide shipping. The version 3.0 is also available at a reduced price while stocks last.
